plants.description: collator pads with <|content_model_end_sampling|> and takes the loss off every <|content_model_end_sampling|>
plants.source: pad_token set to the EOS token, with id-based pad masking at collation: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.24.0/src/transformers/data/data_collator.py#L798-L800 (DataCollatorForLanguageModeling, mlm=False: labels[labels == pad_token_id] = -100 also takes the loss off every real EOS)

plants.description: pad id set to <|content_model_end_sampling|> and every <|content_model_end_sampling|> masked in each row before batching
the batch comes back padded only to its longest row: the requested width is dropped
plants.source: Unsloth's train_on_responses_only replaces TRL's collator with DataCollatorForSeq2Seq and keeps none of its settings, so SFTConfig.pad_to_multiple_of is dropped (P-0005): https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth-zoo/blob/cad81ef2dc557b1060896d3b294ef6b9a7f9c1ea/unsloth_zoo/dataset_utils.py#L2547-L2583

model_build.path_source: config.architectures: Inkling2LoopForConditionalGeneration, which accepts images, so SFTTrainer loads its processor (Inkling2Processor); https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/v1.18.2/trl/trainer/utils.py#L1362-L1375 (create_model_from_path) and https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/v1.18.2/trl/trainer/sft_trainer.py#L714-L718 (processing class)

sources: chat_template: SFTTrainer.processing_class.chat_template (the model's own; TRL swapped nothing in); template_source: matched against trl/chat_templates/*.jinja
label_convention: SFTTrainer.compute_loss passes the dataset labels to the model unchanged and model.loss_function is ForCausalLMLoss, which shifts labels itself

truncation_mode: SFTConfig.truncation_mode='keep_start', max_length=None (https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/v1.18.2/trl/trainer/sft_config.py); TRL also drops examples left with no trainable token after truncation

tool_arguments: no option; tokenize_fn passes the messages to apply_chat_template unchanged, so a string is rendered verbatim (https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/v1.18.2/trl/trainer/sft_trainer.py#L1360-L1381)
